attributes.exact_expressions: Baseline deadline = (f32)(u32)(OSGetTime() / tpms) + 500.0f; order control deadline = 500.0f + (f32)(u32)(OSGetTime() / tpms); split control deadline = (f32)(u32)(OSGetTime() / tpms); deadline += 500.0f;. Inline forms replace initial tpms operand with ((*(u32*)0x800000F8 >> 2) / 1000), with the same order/split alternatives. Source chronology: mgr+12 zero store; G3DInitPadStatus and G3DUpdatePadStatus; clock read1; first OSGetTime conversion/deadline; clock read2; first wait; mbBlitPadTest; deadline+=500; clock read3; second wait; mbBlitPadTest. Target schedules read2 at+0x5c after first __div2i and before finishing FP conversion. The same memory address does not justify merging distinct reads across calls; inline variants lose that read2, so they fail target operation chronology even though a constant bus-clock assumption might mask the difference at runtime.
attributes.source_evidence: src/dolphin/exi/EXIBios.c defines OSTicksToMilliseconds as ticks/(OS_TIMER_CLOCK/1000); include/dolphin/os.h defines OS_TIMER_CLOCK as OS_BUS_CLOCK/4. Xbox exact-name lookup returned no candidate; anonymous function name preserved.
